title: ConvergenceFunction
description: Deterministic decision rule for the Convergence Controller (core-ontology-v3 §8). Universal property: never halts. Decision priority: RE-PLAN → REVISE → FORCE-RESOLVE → GO.

profile_id.description: Genre/Goal profile this convergence config belongs to.

hard_fail_conditions.description: Any true → RE-PLAN. Sensitivity violations are always RE-PLAN; cannot be FORCE-RESOLVEd.

must_have_absent.description: A genre/goal required element (trope, beat, promise) is absent → RE-PLAN.

sensitivity_violation_hard.description: Sensitivity critic hard veto → RE-PLAN only. Sacred: never FORCE-RESOLVE.

dnf_likelihood_ceiling.description: If DNF likelihood exceeds this value → RE-PLAN. Goal-defined.

revise_conditions.description: Any true → REVISE (if max_revise_attempts not exceeded).

weighted_critic_score_floor.description: If weighted aggregate critic score < this floor → REVISE.

weighted_reader_satisfaction_floor.description: If weighted reader satisfaction < this floor → REVISE.

voice_fidelity_distance_ceiling.description: If voice distance > this ceiling → REVISE.

ai_tell_density_ceiling.description: If AI-tell density (per 1000 words) > this ceiling → REVISE.

specificity_index_floor.description: If specificity index < this floor → REVISE.

engagement_floor.description: If engagement score < this floor → REVISE.

promise_ledger_overdue.description: Any critical/high promise overdue at chapter boundary → REVISE.

max_revise_attempts.description: Maximum REVISE iterations before escalating to FORCE-RESOLVE.

force_resolve_policy.description: Applied after max_revise_attempts exceeded. Picks highest-scoring candidate, logs relaxed thresholds, appends issue report entry.

candidate_selection.description: How to pick the winner among available candidates.

log_relaxed_thresholds.description: Relaxed thresholds must be logged in the decision log and calibration log.

append_issue_report.description: Issue report entry is required for every FORCE-RESOLVE.

sacred_thresholds.description: Threshold names that cannot be relaxed even during FORCE-RESOLVE. Sensitivity thresholds are always in this list.

go_conditions.description: All revise conditions pass and no hard fails → GO.

never_halts.description: Universal invariant: the Convergence Controller never halts waiting for human input.

critic_weights.description: Weight map critic_id → float (sum not required to be 1; normalized at runtime). Genre/Goal profiles extend this.
